name: Sentou Tenshi
source:
It hatched from a red crystal - an angel's egg - and did nothing but make unbelievable demands. Clothes and a ring and vacations and even a fighter's assistant?

So in order for an angel to grow up she needs to be dominated by a human? No, she needs to freely devote herself to you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043417.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
它从一枚红色水晶里孵化出来——那其实是天使的蛋。一出生，它便不停地提出匪夷所思的要求：衣服、戒指、度假，居然连打架也要我在旁边打下手？

难道想让天使长大，她就得受人类支配吗？不，她得心甘情愿地为你奉献自己。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043417.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
